How sure: “very sure”, the change holds with county, document type and editor held fixed (q < 0.001) and moves one way; “sure”, it holds (q < 0.05); “place, not time”, no clear change once place is held fixed, but a clear place pattern. MELD 2017.1 (University of Stavanger, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0): dated documents with a known county; a place's documents spiral out from it. Cities: places with 10+ dated documents, each circle's area following its documents in that period. Spelling: “mostly” means three in four of a document's forms. “More of this, more of”: correlation across documents (Spearman, |ρ| ≥ 0.2).
